note: Set A captures several specific, verifiable facts that B misses or mangles: the L3X3X1/4 support angle specification, the 3/8" through-bolt diameter, and the 1 1/2" = 1'-0" drawing scale, and it binds segment lengths (3'-8 3/8", 2'-11 7/8", 2'-3 7/8") to the correct module details. Set B invents property labels that the drawing does not support (web thickness and flange thickness for the 1 1/2" and 5/8" values, thickness 5/8" for Module A) and repeats the same 6", 2", and 4 3/4" values under several vague or duplicate labels. Both sets contain vague entities and duplicated claims, and A also has a misbinding (2'-3 7/8" attributed to MODULE B when it appears in the Module A detail), but B's invented thickness/offset properties and blanket 'Detail A1' conditions on values from the Module B detail are more damaging.
